sources.label: KK Yap & Associates XSGD SCS Reserve Account Report, 30 June 2026

reserveReview.rationale: KK Yap & Associates SSAE 3000 (Revised) reasonable-assurance examination as of 30 June 2026 11:59 PM SGT (report dated 2026-07-29, PDF read this pass): S$11,330,779 cash and S$12,343,929 of <=3-month MAS/government bonds or eligible overnight reverse repos (single combined category by design), totalling S$23,674,708 marked-to-market reserves against S$23,661,169 XSGD in circulation (coverage ~100.06%). The examination affirms MAS asset-category, daily mark-to-market, segregated-trust and pegged-currency requirements but does not split the bills/repo category or name the safeguarding institution.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: KK Yap & Associates independent examination as of 30 June 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The independent examination discloses the complete current reserve allocation between cash and a defined short-dated MAS/government-bill or eligible overnight-repo category. It does not split that second category between bills and repos, identify the safeguarding institution, or publish provider-level allocation.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: StraitsX names CIMB, DBS, and Standard Chartered Singapore and permits other MAS-approved institutions, but does not publish provider shares, the current complete provider set, or rehypothecation terms. The trust structure and exclusion from the issuer's unsecured-creditor estate are explicit.
